mechanism_narrative: A positive revision in the quarterly GDP (GDPC1) relative to the prior estimate indicates stronger economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with positive GDPC1 revision (revised > vintage value).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and fall in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economy that can support monetary tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp in 3 months AND UNRATE falling > 0.1pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A lower Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower discount rates and thus positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 255 signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 255.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with HOUST rising > 0.1% in 1 month AND INDPRO rising > 0.1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During a strong labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in the last month), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 AND PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in the last month.
